_about: What the gate covers. Add an entry when a document, an STL folder, a .3mf project or a generator script joins the project: an entry widens coverage. Removing one narrows it: ask the owner first. templates: .3mf files that hold settings and no mesh (the empty project a build starts from); such a file is not verified and not reported as unregistered while it holds no mesh. A part is exported to <stl_dir>/<part slug>.stl; a document may give single parts another file with "stl_names": {"<part name exactly as the census shows it, or its part slug>": "<file name>.stl"} (a file name inside its stl_dir; for a project whose STL files and build table already have their own names). It takes effect with the next scan. A mapped file may not be another part's file or a generator's STL.
